[[File:Bones to Peaches icon (mobile).png|left]]
'''Bones to Peaches''' is a [[spell]] that can be used to turn all [[Bones|normal bones]], [[burnt bones]], [[bat bones]], [[bleached bones]], [[jogre bones]], [[wolf bones]], [[monkey bones]], [[Alan's bones]], [[animals' bones]], and [[big bones]] in the inventory into [[peach]]es, which can be eaten to heal 8 [[Hitpoints]]. Before it can be cast, it must be unlocked from the [[Mage Training Arena]], which costs all of the following:
{| class="wikitable"
!Amount
!Task
|-
|200
|[[Mage Training Arena/Telekinetic Theatre|Telekinetic]] pizazz points
|-
|300
|[[Mage Training Arena/Alchemist's Playground|Alchemist]] pizazz points
|-
|2,000
|[[Mage Training Arena/Enchanting Chamber|Enchantment]] pizazz points
|-
|200
|[[Mage Training Arena/Creature Graveyard|Graveyard]] pizazz points
|}
Unlocking this spell requires level 60 Magic, this requirement is [[Temporary skill boost/Magic|boostable]].

Its [[Bones to peaches (tablet)|tablet form]] is usable without unlocking the spell, albeit granting no experience. However, ''crafting'' the tablet requires the player to have unlocked the spell.

Bones to Peaches is commonly used to extend trips when food is scarce but bones are plentiful, such as in the [[God Wars Dungeon]]. Players may also consider the healing effect of [[Guthan the Infested's equipment|Guthan's equipment]] as an alternative (or in addition) to the spell. Tablets can be used to save inventory space instead of bringing the runes required to cast the spell.

[[Remains#Demonic ashes|Demonic ashes]] cannot be converted as they are not considered bones. Attempting to convert bones of a higher tier than big bones gives the message {{mes|The bones you're holding aren't suitable for peachifying.}} Attempting to cast the spell without any bones gives the message {{mes|You aren't holding any bones!}}

Casting the spell in the [[Al Kharid Palace]] is a hard task in the [[Lumbridge & Draynor Diary]] (using the tablet form of the spell '''does not''' work).
